Subject: Renewal notice + SOC 2 re-attestation evidence and seat increase

Hi Marta / Garry —

Hope you’re both well. As we approach Helix Financial’s contract renewal window (current term ends 2028-09-30), I wanted to align on two parallel tracks: the SOC 2 re-attestation evidence your team requires for renewal, and the seat/retention uplift we discussed in last quarter’s QBR.

High level asks from our side:
- Confirm the evidence list Helix needs for the SOC 2 re-attestation (we’ve attached a suggested manifest to speed triage).
- Confirm desired retention window for account audit logs (current standard: 90 days; you mentioned 365 days in QBR).
- Confirm target seat increase and billing treatment (we sketched a 20% seat uplift and a term amendment; see attached draft amendment).

Attachments: SOC2_evidence_manifest.xlsx (master manifest), redwood_amendment_proposal.docx (draft terms)

Proposed next step: 30–45 minute evidence-handoff call next week to share sample logs, upload method, and finalize amendment language. What times work for your security team?

Thanks — we want to make this as low-friction as possible so your security/IT can validate before the renewal.

Best,
Avery Johnson

Subject: Re: Renewal notice + SOC 2 re-attestation evidence and seat increase

Thanks Avery — appreciate the clear plan and the manifest. A few quick clarifications from Helix security:

1) Retention: We do want 365-day retention for audit logs for the corporate account (to meet our internal retention policy). Please confirm whether that will require a configuration change or an amendment to our contract as a billable add-on.

2) Evidence format: For the re-attestation we typically need:
   - System architecture & control maps
   - Sample application logs (auth, admin activity) for a 2-week window
   - Any KMS/HSM configuration docs and key rotation cadence
   - A named contact for upload coordination and SSO service account permissions

3) Upload mechanism: We prefer S3 presigned uploads or secure SFTP. Can you confirm options/support on your side?

We can do a call Wed or Thu next week. CC’ing our security vendor (Sam Patel from AuditEdge) to coordinate the evidence ingest cadence.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
Director of Security Engineering | Helix Financial
marta.ruiz@helixfin.com

Marta — thanks for the list, that maps cleanly to what we usually provide. A few operational notes from our side:

- Retention: 365 days is available as a configurable tier. It requires a retention add-on (monthly) and a short config change on our storage tier. I’ll attach a cost snapshot in the thread.
- Upload options: we support both S3 presigned uploads (preferred) and secure SFTP. For S3 we provide temporary presigned links and an ingestion manifest format.
- KMS/HSM: Redwood supports customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) for Private deployments; for hosted customers we provide an HSM-backed managed KMS with rotation logs. Markus, can you add the exact rotation cadence and an export of our key policy?

Avery — I updated the draft amendment (redwood_amendment_proposal.docx) with a clause for the 12-month retention uplift and a line item for the 20% seat increase pro-rated for the remainder of the term. Naomi will run the evidence intake once we agree on the upload method.

Next steps proposed:
1) 30-minute sync Thurs 2028-07-12 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET (we can push if not convenient)
2) Sam/AuditEdge will confirm whether they need a staging manifest format change
3) We will provide a short sample log bundle ahead of the call (log_sample_202806.tar.gz)

Thanks — I’ll join the call and share the cost snapshot.

Regards,

Hi all — Sam from AuditEdge here (cc Garry for visibility). Quick technical notes from the auditor POV:

- Manifest: The SOC2_evidence_manifest.xlsx looks fine but we prefer a CSV manifest with columns: filename, SHA256, record_start, record_end, source_type. If Redwood can generate a manifest in that format it will speed automated intake.
- Upload: S3 presigned uploads are ideal. We can also accept GCS signed URLs if needed. For SFTP we’ll need user/key provisioning details.
- Sample logs: the tar bundle looks reasonable; please ensure auth logs include IP, user-agent, and request-id fields. Mask PII where applicable or provide a redaction manifest.

We can standby on Thu 07/12 10:00 PT for the handoff. If you want, AuditEdge can coordinate an automated ingestion run to validate checksums on a dry-run.

Regards,
Sam Patel
Security Audit Engineer | AuditEdge
sam@auditedge.io
